name: Delta Stream
description: For as long as this Pokémon is engaged in combat, the weather is Strong Winds and cannot be changed. In Strong Winds, Flying-type pokemon ignore their vulnerabilities granted by their flying type; if their secondary type grants vulnerability or resistance to one of those types, it follows the secondary type. If Primordial Sea or Desolate Land is also active, then the weather is simultaneously Strong Winds in addition to the weather caused by those abilities.
